explanations.interface: Haytham is a Claude Code plugin. The user invokes it from inside a Claude Code CLI session via slash commands. There is no web UI, no separate native app, and no API surface for external callers. Output is rendered as text in the session and as files under .haytham/session/ or openspec/.
explanations.auth: Haytham has no users of its own. Identity, authorization, and access control are inherited from the host Claude Code subscription. The plugin does not store credentials and does not gate any feature behind auth.
explanations.deployment: The plugin is published to the Claude Code plugin marketplace. Installation is /plugin marketplace add followed by /plugin install. There is no cloud-hosted backend, no container image, and no per-tenant infrastructure to operate.
explanations.data_layer: All state is filesystem. Pipeline state lives under .haytham/session/phase-N/. The maintained reasoning graph lives under openspec/. Demo exports live under a separate demos repository chosen by the user. No remote database, no cache layer, no managed object store.
explanations.realtime: No component requires live data push. The pipeline is a synchronous sequence of agent invocations, each finishing before the next begins. Variants in /haytham:evolve run in parallel but the orchestrator waits for all three before synthesizing.
explanations.communication: Haytham does not send messages on behalf of the user. Outreach summaries are generated as files the user can copy and send manually. No email, SMS, or chat integration is built in.
explanations.payments: There is no payment surface. The plugin is open-source and free to install. Users pay Anthropic for their Claude Code subscription; Haytham does not transact.
explanations.scheduling: No timed jobs, cron triggers, or background workers. Every action is user-initiated via a slash command. Future Sentience milestone may add scheduled telemetry analysis, but that is explicitly out of MVP scope.
